findings.text: The headline count is wrong against the table it summarizes: `census.md` line 12 claims "73 classes, 27 worth a view", but the table (diff.patch lines 17–92) actually lists 76 rows, and counting the "worth a view" column by hand gives 36 "yes" rows, not 27 — readers will trust the headline over a manual recount, so it needs to match the table (or the table needs trimming to 73/27).

The sort requirement ("worth a view: yes first, most useful first") isn't followed globally — `no` rows are interspersed among `yes` rows by module family (e.g. Draggable/Sortable as `no` sit between Timeline and Auth, both `yes`, around diff.patch line 43–46), instead of all "yes" rows preceding all "no" rows as the brief asked.

The property names in "What Page and App views should show first" (diff.patch lines 100–109) check out against `core/Page/Page.class.js` — `navigation`, `arrangement`, `background`, `type_size` are real fields there — so that section is solid and doesn't need rework.

Worth a quick sanity check that `ui/` and `web/` truly export zero classes (diff.patch line 9 claims this) — a grep for `^export (default )?class` across `core ext ux` alone turned up more matches (82) than the table's row count, so the exclusion criteria used for the walk may be worth re-stating in the doc for the next reader.
